items.question: Em Does your plane leave in the morning or in the evening? EW
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Em Does your plane leave in the morning or in the evening? EW”，自然应答是“At eight o'clock tomorrow morning.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（At eight o'clock tomorrow morning.）。
